verdict.rationale: TaxJar exposes a well-documented REST API with API-key auth, versioned headers, a sandbox endpoint, and official client SDKs across seven languages, all confirmed by first-party docs and the taxjar-node GitHub client covering core operations (tax calc, order creation, address/VAT validation, nexus regions). Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec or llms.txt for automated agent discovery (both probes 404'd), which slightly limits AI-native machine-readability.
